comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
Part of the Prosperity of Ancient Egypt Memorial Album, this Sailor Equip item is created using Sophia points obtained from Legacy theme discoveries. Requires Transmutation Alchemy Equipment or Complex Alchemy Equipment furniture. Recipe:

Base item: Introduction to Navigation
Handicrafts/Alchemy R11
Sophia points consumed per production: 250

Ingredients:
The Sun's Gemstone x1
Custom Salvage Rope x20
Ventus Reduction x10
20% chance of success

As with all Transmutation Alchemy recipes, Book of Uroboros items work fine. Sadly, Book of the Wingless Dragon do not. Stats:

Durability 50
Vertical Sail +4
Horizontal Sail +12
Turn Speed +1
Wave Resistance -1
Armour -1

Sadly, Sailor Equipment loses durability quite rapidly and can only be repaired using the following items:

Simple Sailor Equip. Repair Tools
Sailor Equip. Repair Tools
Advanced Sailor Equip. Repair Tools

Availability of those items on Maris is quite scarce for the most part. Take good care of it. Cheers.
